Our onboarding email had a 4 percent reply rate for three years.

Last month an intern rewrote it as two sentences and a question about the reader's Monday.

Reply rate is now 31 percent. The question was: what is the first thing you want this tool to take off your plate?

We spent two years on the product tour. The intern spent forty minutes on the email.

I am not saying tours are useless. I am saying nobody replies to a tour.
